variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the built-in administrator account used to access the admin interface.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the built-in administrator account. Choose a strong unique password before exposing the app.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret used to sign admin session cookies. Generate a long unpredictable value.

variables.name: TRAITS_DIR
variables.description: Directory containing trait markdown files. Relative paths are resolved from config/.env.
